sloka: बलैस्तु सङ्कुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः ।मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत् ।। ५.६८.१४ ।।।।
transliteration: balaistu saṅkulāṁ kṛtvā laṅkāṁ parabalārdanaḥ ।māṁ nayedyadi kākutsthastattasya sadṛśaṁ bhavet ।। 5.68.14 ।।।।

translations.english: 'If Rama, the slayer of the enemy army, could fill Lanka with his arrows and take me that will be a good sight for him to see.
